user_problem: Requests are routed inconsistently because category, urgency, location, and exception rules are scattered.
unique_output: A deterministic routing table with conditions, destination role, precedence, fallback, and ambiguity cases.
required_input: Request categories, routing rules, precedence clauses, role directory, and approved fallback destination.
critical_rule: Never choose between overlapping rules without supplied precedence; send unresolved cases only to the approved fallback.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is approval-path-mapper; this routes incoming work rather than mapping authorization decisions.
acceptance_scenario: Input routes billing to Finance, urgent site outages to On-call regardless of category, and all unknowns to Coordinator. Output routes an urgent billing outage to On-call and an uncategorized request to Coordinator.
